lines.q: Who was the leader of the Gunpowder Plot?
lines.a: Robert Catesby! Guy Fawkes was just the explosives man.

lines.q: In what year was the Gunpowder Plot?
lines.a: Sixteen oh five! On the fifth of November.

lines.q: Which building did the plotters try to blow up?
lines.a: The House of Lords! During the state opening of Parliament, with King James inside.

lines.q: Last one. How many barrels of gunpowder were hidden under Parliament?
lines.a: Thirty six! Enough to flatten the building. Think you can get all four? Go again!
